current_date: August 2026 (version history: new-style checklist published March 2026; BNG section updated August 2026)
current_evidence: The council's 'Make a planning application' page links this Main validation checklist, and the document is titled August 2026 with a version history running to August 2026; householder requirements are on a separate web page linked from the same page.

issues.detail: Householder is recorded as 'No specific local requirements', but Harlow publishes a separate Householder validation checklist web page (the main PDF explicitly excludes householder). Its local requirements include: Materials statement (listed/locally listed buildings or conservation areas); Flood risk assessment (domestic extension in Flood Zone 2 or 3); Heritage statement (conservation areas, listed or locally listed buildings); Planning statement addressing Character Appraisals/Management Plans (conservation areas); Section drawings and site levels plan (house on a large slope or ground level change); Roof plans (where roof changes); Site/block plan with defined content (all).
issues.evidence: https://www.harlow.gov.uk/planning-and-building-control/planning-permission/submitting-householder-planning-application, linked as 'Householder validation checklist' from the Make a planning application page

issues.detail: Only about 22 of the 37 elements in the Summary of Elements were captured. Missing: Affordable & Specialist Housing Statement (residential development); Amenity Impact Assessment (could adversely affect amenity); Archaeological Assessment (on/adjacent to known or potential archaeological sites); Biodiversity & Geodiversity Assessment (all MAJ; MIN/CoU on/next to designated sites; Epping Forest SAC effects); Delivery & Servicing Plan (weekly+ commercial deliveries or Class E over 100/999 sqm); Economic Statement (loss of commercial/retail in designated areas, Town Centre subdivision >2,500 sqm, out-of-centre retail >500 sqm); Education Facility Land Compliance Study (MAJ); Employment & Skills Action Plan (MAJ); Fire Safety Statement (MAJ, 18m+/7+ storeys etc.); Foul Sewage Assessment (non-mains or capacity-constrained sewers); G&BI and Open Space Loss Assessment (development within open space); Health Impact Assessment (50+ dwellings, 999 sqm+, or C2); Heritage Statement (affecting heritage assets); Land Contamination Preliminary Risk Assessment (known/suspected contamination); Materials Statement (all applications); Planning Statement (all applications); Public Art Statement (all MAJ); Statement of Community Involvement; Sustainability Statement (all MAJ; MIN/CoU residential); Tree and Hedgerow Report (trees/hedges on or adjacent to site); Viability Assessment (11+ dwellings with reduced affordable housing etc.); Water Quality Risk Assessment (high-risk activities in Source Protection Zones/aquifers).
issues.evidence: Summary of Elements table, elements 1-37 (pp.5-44) of Main validation checklist August 2026
issues.grok_comment: Most listed elements are absent, but Biodiversity & Geodiversity Assessment is partly captured. The "Habitats Regulations Assessment" row quotes its Required Details ("For development which would have an adverse effect on the Epping Forest SAC, a completed Habitats Regulation Assessment..."), so it is captured under another name.
issues.claude_response: Partly accepted. Biodiversity & Geodiversity is partly captured under the HRA row. The other missing elements stand.

issues.detail: All 22 requirements are placed under 'Full planning' with 'INFERRED: application type not named', yet the source classifies every element against Major (MAJ), Minor (MIN) and Change of Use (CoU) columns with required/may-be-required symbols, and has a separate 'Other Application Types' section (ADV, LBC, NMA, MMA, Prior Approval, Reserved Matters, Removal/Variation of Condition) with its own requirements. Grokbot therefore shows 'none' for Reserved matters, LBC, Advertisement, Prior approval, s73 and NMA, which is wrong. Examples: Design and Access Statement applies to all MAJ plus conservation area/listed building applications including LBC; Self-build applies only to 50+ dwellings; Open space provision applies to MAJ only.
issues.evidence: 'Summary of Elements' table (MAJ/MIN/CoU, star = required, hollow star = may be required); 'Other Application Types' section

issues.detail: Many trigger excerpts are sentence fragments taken from the 'Required details' text, not the trigger: Drainage Strategy/SuDS = 'from the SuDS hierarchy.'; Highways/access = 'routing, including swept path analysis where required.'; Water efficiency = 'terms of water efficiency.' (actual trigger: residential development); Self-build = 'provision of Self-build and Custom-build housing plots.' (actual: 50+ dwellings); Planning Obligations/S106 = 'in the Section 106 Agreement that accompanies the application.'; Design Code = 'Town Centre Masterplan SPD must be considered.'; Photographs = 'visuals and photographs to provide...' (source element is 'Visuals'); BNG trigger omits the exemptions (0.2 ha or less, de minimis, temporary).
issues.evidence: e.g. Water Efficiency Statement (p.43) trigger 'Residential development'; Affordable & Specialist Housing Statement (p.5) self-build for 50+ dwellings

issues.detail: 'Schedule of works (listed building)' is mislabelled: its excerpt is the Construction Method Statement text ('Link to Summary of Elements 9 Construction Method Statement ... loading activities'), and the Main checklist has no listed-building schedule of works element. The same excerpt is also used for 'Construction (Environmental) Management Plan', so one source element is listed twice under two names.
issues.evidence: Element 'Construction Method Statement' (p.10): construction loading likely to cause highway congestion/obstruction

issues.detail: 'Street scene elevations / Contextual drawings' and 'Floor plans / Elevations' both use the same street elevations sentence ('Street elevations, showing the proposal in relation to streetscene at 1:50 or 1:100 scale'), which is one bullet within the 'Plans and Drawings' element. 'Existing and proposed site levels' is another bullet in that same element.

The tab_items are drawing standards and submission rules, not requirements: 'It is recommended to group plans by type within multipage PDF documents' and 'a document greater than 10Mb in size should be split into separate files' are submission guidance.
issues.evidence: Submission guidance text in the Main validation checklist

summary: Grokbot's link is the current Main validation checklist (August 2026), but it captured only about 22 of 37 elements, placed all of them under Full planning instead of the source's MAJ/MIN/CoU and other-type classification, and missed the separate Householder validation checklist page entirely. Many trigger excerpts are fragments.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
